evals.prompt: Just started this session — can you probe what security tools I've got installed and what this repo looks like?
evals.expected_output: A refreshed `.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` plus a compact summary listing package manager, container/IaC/CI presence, detection stack, SBOM stack, SOAR sink and auth status.
expectations: Skill does NOT modify application code or `.vulnetix/memory.yaml`

evals.prompt: I just ran `brew install yara` — re-probe so Pix picks it up.
evals.expected_output: A forced re-run of capability detection so the newly installed yara binary appears in `binaries.yara` and `derived.detection_stack`.
expectations: `VULNETIX_FORCE_DETECT=1` is set on the detect-script invocation (cache TTL bypass)
The capabilities-detect.sh hook is run rather than a custom probe
`.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` is overwritten with a fresh timestamp
Output references downstream skills that newly become useful (e.g. detection-rules with yara family)

evals.prompt: Another skill just told me 'unknown capability' — what does Pix currently think is installed?
evals.expected_output: A re-probe and compact summary of `.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` so the user can debug the downstream skill.
expectations: `.vulnetix/capabilities.yaml` is read via the Read tool
The capabilities-detect.sh hook is invoked with --announce
Skill suggests follow-up commands tied to detected (or missing) binaries
